name: Garmin Track Cycling Saddle Mount

specs.Main material: Aluminium alloy seat support, plastic base

description:
A clean track bike leaves very little room for anything unnecessary. That includes where you put your head unit.

The Garmin Track Cycling Saddle Mount is a simple but genuinely useful solution for riders who want to run a Garmin device on the track without cluttering the bars, stem or cockpit. Mounted beneath the saddle, it gives you a neat, protected and race-friendly position for your unit while keeping the front end of the bike clean.

For riders using Garmin to monitor training, review efforts, capture lap data or simply keep their setup organised during warm-up and track sessions, this is an elegant answer. It is especially useful on sprint and pursuit bikes where bar space can be limited and cockpit cleanliness matters.

Built from sturdy aluminium alloy with a lightweight base, the mount is designed for long-term use and day-to-day reliability. The angle can also be adjusted by removing the screws, allowing you to fine-tune the position to suit your saddle setup and viewing preference.

This is one of those small details that makes a track bike work better.

Key Features

Purpose-led under-saddle Garmin mount for track cycling use

Keeps the cockpit clean and uncluttered

Strong aluminium alloy seat support construction

Lightweight design at approximately 34g

Adjustable angle for improved positioning

Clean black finish

Compact overall size: approx. 6.3cm x 3.7cm x 3.7cm

Why use an under-saddle Garmin mount on a track bike?

Track bikes are different. Space is tighter, setups are cleaner, and many riders do not want a conventional out-front mount or handlebar mount disrupting the feel or look of the bike.

Mounting the head unit under the saddle gives you a more discreet location for training use while freeing up valuable room around the bars and stem. It also suits riders who want data collection on the bike without turning the cockpit into a road-style setup.

For coaches, performance riders and serious track cyclists, it is a tidy solution that makes practical sense.

The main seat support section is made from aluminium alloy for strength and durability, while the base section is plastic. The result is a mount that feels sturdy in use without adding unnecessary weight.

Specification

Main material: Aluminium alloy seat support, plastic base

Colour: Black

Size: Approx. 6.3cm x 3.7cm x 3.7cm

Weight: Approx. 34g

Adjustment: Angle adjustable by removing screws

Compatibility

Designed for Garmin-style quarter-turn head unit attachment.

Suitable for riders using Garmin Edge computers on the track, including popular models such as the Edge 540, 840, 1040 and 1050, along with other compatible Garmin units using the same mount interface.

As with any mount, please check compatibility with your specific device and saddle setup before use.

Garmin Track Cycling Saddle Mount - Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Is this intended for track bikes only?
It is especially well suited to track bikes because it helps keep the cockpit clean and uncluttered, but it may also suit other bikes depending on your saddle setup and preference.

Will it fit my Garmin Edge?
It is designed around the standard Garmin-style quarter-turn interface used by many Edge units. Please check your device and mount interface before ordering.

Can the angle be adjusted?
Yes. The angle can be adjusted after removing the screws.

Is it heavy?
No. At approximately 34g, it is a lightweight addition to the bike.

Is the head unit included?
No. This product is the mount only.

Velodrome.Shop is built around real track cycling use, not generic cycling retail. We focus on equipment that makes sense for track riders, from elite performance products through to the small setup details that improve how a bike works in training and competition.

name: gebioMized Stride

specs.Nose width: 55 mm, measured 5 cm behind the tip
specs.Transition width: 75 mm, measured 10 cm behind the tip

description:
The gebioMized Stride Neutral is a performance saddle designed for riders who need stability, pressure relief and support in an aggressive aerodynamic position.

One of the most popular saddles amongst professional Track Cyclists.

For track cycling, the saddle is not just a comfort item. It affects how well the rider can hold their position, how stable the pelvis remains under load, and how consistently power can be produced when the body is rotated forwards over the front of the bike.

The Stride is especially well suited to modern track positions, where riders often sit further forward, ride narrower cockpits, and place more load through the front section of the saddle. Its shape supports both a forward aero position and a slightly more central seated position, giving the rider usable support without excessive movement or pressure build-up.

We only offer the Neutral version because it is the best option for serious track use. The neutral-density foam gives a firmer, more stable platform than the softer version, making it better suited to shorter, harder efforts, high-cadence riding and aggressive velodrome positions where control and repeatability matter.

The broad nose, smooth transition area and compact rear section help support the pelvis while still allowing leg clearance during high-speed pedalling. For pursuit, bunch racing, sprint training, time trial-style efforts and modern aero track bike setups, the gebioMized Stride Neutral is a strong choice.

Key Features

Track-focused aero saddle

Neutral-density foam for a stable, supportive feel

Designed for forward-rotated, aerodynamic riding positions

Suitable for front-loaded and mid-loaded saddle positions

Helps reduce unwanted movement on the saddle

Supports pelvic stability during high-power riding

Titanium rails

Black finish with white gebioMized logos

Approximate weight: 250-260 g

Rear width: 130 mm

Nose width: 55 mm, measured 5 cm behind the tip

Transition width: 75 mm, measured 10 cm behind the tip

Why Neutral for Track Cycling?

Track riders normally need a saddle that offers support rather than softness.

On the velodrome, the rider is often holding a fixed position under high load, with limited opportunity to move around or relieve pressure. A saddle that is too soft can feel comfortable at first, but may allow too much movement or create instability when the rider is producing power.

The Stride Neutral gives a more direct platform, which is why we consider it the best version for track cycling. It supports the rider in a forward aero position while keeping the contact point controlled and consistent.

Suitable For

Track cycling

Individual pursuit

Team pursuit

Kilo and 500 m TT

Bunch racing

Sprint training

Aero track bike setups

Time trial-style velodrome positions

Why Buy From Velodrome.Shop?

Velodrome.Shop specialises in track cycling equipment and rider position demands, rather than treating track products as an add-on to road or triathlon ranges. We select products based on how they work in the velodrome environment: fixed gear, high cadence, aggressive aero positions, repeated maximal efforts and modern UCI position requirements. The gebioMized Stride Neutral is offered because it suits those demands particularly well. If you are building or refining a serious track bike setup, we can also advise on how the saddle choice fits alongside cockpit position, stem length, handlebar width and overall aero position.

This item is available with Free International Shipping

gebioMized Stride Saddle FAQs

Is the gebioMized Stride suitable for track cycling?

Yes. The Stride Neutral is very well suited to track cycling, especially for riders using a forward, aerodynamic position.

Why do you only offer the Neutral version?

We only offer the Neutral version because it gives the best balance of support, stability and pressure distribution for track cycling. The softer version may suit some long-distance triathlon riders, but for track use we prefer the firmer, more controlled feel of the Neutral model.

Is this saddle suitable for pursuit riders?

Yes. It is a strong option for individual pursuit and team pursuit riders because it supports a forward-rotated aero position while helping the rider stay stable under sustained power.

Is it suitable for sprint riders?

Yes, particularly for sprint riders using aggressive aero setups in training or timed efforts. Saddle preference is always personal, but the firm and stable platform of the Stride Neutral makes sense for many high-power track riders.

Does it work with standard seatposts?

The Stride Neutral uses titanium rails, so it is compatible with standard saddle clamps designed for round metal rails. Always check your seatpost clamp type before fitting.

Is this a comfort saddle?

It is a performance saddle first. The aim is not soft, casual comfort, but stable support and pressure management in an aggressive riding position.

What riding position is it best for?

It is best for riders who sit forward on the saddle, rotate the pelvis forwards and hold an aerodynamic position. This makes it especially relevant to modern track, TT and triathlon-style positions.

name: PRO Shimano Stealth Superlight Carbon Rail Saddle
description:
The PRO Shimano Stealth Superlight Carbon Rail Saddle is one of the most popular saddles with professional Track Cyclists. The Stealth Superlight's state-of-the-art construction sees a one-piece design seamlessly integrating saddle and rails, resulting in a 15% weight reduction

Unique structure sheds 27g over the standard carbon version, tipping the scales at only 145g

Cutting-edge carbon weave pattern and precision fibre lay-up construction increases both stiffness and compliance

With increased compliance in the base, the padding and cover material have been upgraded to support sitbone comfort and alleviate pressure points in three main positions ‐ on the hoods, drops and tops

The polyurethane cover, which sits over lightweight EVA foam, was tested with a variety of bib short materials to find the lowest friction rates between rider and saddle

The Stealth Superlight retains the original shape, a wide cut-out channel in the middle, offering extra comfort for riders on the edge

To retain saddle stiffness and power transfer the base includes horizontal reinforcement bridges, all part of the unique one-piece carbon reinforced base

Weight ‐ 145g

Saddle Rail - Carbon
Shape - Anatomic
Width - 142 or 152mm

name: Shimano PRO TSA 1.1 Carbon Saddle
description:
The Shimano PRO TSA Carbon Saddle is a short length time trial saddle designed to facilitate an aerodynamic position on the bike. It features a carbon reinforced base and is available with carbon rails.
It replaces the classic PRO Aerofuel used for years by the worlds best time triallers.

Triathletes, Pursuit and time trial riders typically require a highly aerodynamic position on the saddle. The PRO TSA TT/Tri Saddle facilitates this aggressive position. It has a short length, carbon reinforced base, which is set on carbon or stainless steel rails and features lightweight EVA padding. A broad anatomic fit cut-out and strategically varied padding densities helps to reduce saddle pressure on soft tissue, while maintaining an aerodynamic position on the bike throughout a time trail or a triathlon bike leg. It is only available in a 132 millimeter width and weighs 170g

Features:

Provides an aerodynamic position on the saddle

Short length design

Anatomic fit cut-out

Carbon Reinforced Base

Carbon or Stainless Steel Rails

Lightweight EVA Padding

PU Cover
